parts.title: Translate principles into checks
parts.body: Terms such as fairness and transparency need concrete behavior in a particular setting. Ask who could be harmed, what explanation a user needs, how an outcome can be challenged, and which evidence will show a control works. Match oversight to impact. Human review is meaningful only when reviewers have enough time, information, and authority to change the result.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Test a loan assistance tool
parts.body: If an assistant drafts explanations for declined applications, require it to use verified decision reasons, disclose its role to staff, and avoid invented factors. Audit a sample for accuracy and clarity. Name the person who handles a customer's challenge.
parts.label: Apply
